Puma Chief Commercial Officer Matthias Baeumer to Step Down
Puma said its chief commercial officer, Matthias Baeumer, has decided to step down from the management board at the end of the month for personal reasons.

The German sportswear group said Friday that a successor will be announced in due course, with Chief Executive Arthur Hoeld overseeing the company's sales organization and subsidiaries in the meantime.

Baeumer has been with Puma for almost 20 years, holding various senior leadership roles. He will remain a consultant to the company while continuing to represent Puma on the supervisory board of German football club Borussia Dortmund.
